purpose: Hindsight evaluation of LCC rookie-draft player outcomes and owner-class outcomes, kept separate from Draft-Day Intelligence.

playerOutcome.definition: Objective fantasy production of the drafted player, independent of later LCC ownership.
primarySignals: season fantasy totals derived from weekly points

draftCapitalEfficiency.definition: Outcome relative to the acquisition cost represented by draft slot or broad pick band.
draftCapitalEfficiency.baselineRecommendation: Use broad empirical pick bands with descriptive medians and quartiles; do not invent hit thresholds.

lineupImpact.definition: How often the drafted player became a usable LCC starter or lineup contributor.
lineupImpact.separationRule: Player Outcome owns production magnitude; Lineup Impact owns deployment frequency and usability.

longevity.definition: Sustained productive usefulness across post-draft seasons.
longevity.minimumRule: Roster survival alone is insufficient; a longevity season requires production or usage support.

valueRealized.definition: Objective value retained, used, or directly converted by the original drafting owner.
valueRealized.tradeRule: Trade events remain descriptive context in V1; received assets are not assigned retrospective numeric value without objective evidence.
valueRealized.successionRule: Successor-franchise production is not silently assigned to the original drafting owner.

scoreArchitecture.overallScore: continuous weighted mean; no quantization before letter conversion
scoreArchitecture.letterScale: existing LCC Draft Intelligence A+ through F thresholds; no curve

deterministicScoringRules.playerOutcome: Position-specific empirical quintile rank of maturity-normalized per-observed-season fantasy production; score 1 through 5 by rank quintile, with stable player-ID tie breaking.
deterministicScoringRules.capitalEfficiency: Position-normalized Player Outcome production percentile ranked within the same four 12-pick band distributions; score 1 through 5 by band-relative rank quintile.
deterministicScoringRules.lineupImpact: Position-specific empirical quintile rank of starter appearances divided by rostered observation weeks; score 1 through 5 with stable tie breaking.
deterministicScoringRules.longevity: Count seasons meeting the position-specific positive-season median production threshold, divided by seasonsElapsed; rank within maturity status by empirical quintile with stable tie breaking.
deterministicScoringRules.valueRealized: Score a deterministic blend of original-owner production share (50%), original-owner starter-appearance share (30%), and original-owner productive-season share (20%) by empirical quintile rank; no trade-return value.
deterministicScoringRules.missingEvidence: Missing required evidence produces UNAVAILABLE confidence and does not mechanically lower an otherwise calculated numeric dimension.

maturity.2025Treatment: EARLY_OUTCOME_SNAPSHOT_ONLY; no mature overall Outcome Grade.
maturity.developingTreatment: Display DEVELOPING maturity and confidence disclosure; do not present as equivalent to mature classes.

normalization.production: Use cohort- and maturity-aware per-season measures and empirical percentiles; raw multi-season totals are descriptive only.
normalization.position: Use position-specific baselines for QB/RB/WR/TE before comparison; do not compare raw totals blindly across positions.
normalization.scoringAuthority: Stored LCC matchup fantasy points are authoritative; do not substitute generic scoring.
normalization.smallSamples: Sparse position or maturity cohorts remain descriptive and receive reduced confidence rather than invented thresholds.

positionScope.excludedTreatment: Preserve as diagnostic evidence only until Rookie Draft scope and sample support are separately approved.

aggregation.playerRecord: One record per drafted player per evaluation snapshot, with separate component evidence and confidence.
aggregation.ownerClass: Aggregate player records by drafting owner using a bounded contribution method; no single player should dominate without draft-cost and outcome support.
aggregation.capitalWeighting: Keep acquisition cost inside Draft Capital Efficiency; do not apply a second capital multiplier to the overall player aggregation.
aggregation.succession: Separate player outcome, original-owner value realized, and successor-franchise context.

doubleCountingProtections: Starter points cannot also be treated as full Player Outcome credit.
Starter appearances measure deployment frequency, not production magnitude.
Rostered seasons are context and cannot independently establish Longevity.
Capital Efficiency owns draft cost; no second overall capital multiplier is applied.
Original-owner production is Value Realized evidence and is not reassigned to Player Outcome.

scoreScale.reason: Preserves consistency with Draft-Day architecture while retaining precision in a future synthesis layer.

letterScale.reuse: A+ through F Draft Intelligence thresholds

weightDecision: FROZEN_FOR_CALIBRATION: Player Outcome 35%, Capital Efficiency 25%, Lineup Impact 15%, Longevity 15%, Value Realized 10%. Value Realized remains capped because trade-return valuation is not modeled.

confidence.rule: Confidence is separate from numerical result and is constrained by the weakest materially required evidence component.

snapshotVersioning.example: 2024 evaluated 2025-12-31 under outcome-grade-v1 remains separate from 2024 evaluated 2026-12-31 under outcome-grade-v1.

approval.approvalScope: Authoritative historical Outcome snapshots for draft seasons 2021–2025 only.
approval.futureChangeRule: Any methodology change requires a new outcome-grade-v1.1 or outcome-grade-v2 artifact; outcome-grade-v1 records are never rewritten.

statusNote: APPROVED — outcome-grade-v1 is immutable for authoritative 2021–2025 historical snapshots at the ownership-ledger-v1 evaluation boundary.
